description: This file implements backoff strategies for gRPC connections, including an exponential backoff algorithm, and provides a utility function RunF to repeatedly execute a function with backoff logic.

classes.name: Exponential
classes.description: Implements exponential backoff algorithm with configurable parameters.

methods.name: Backoff
methods.description: Calculates the backoff duration based on the number of retries.

methods.name: RunF
methods.description: Runs a function repeatedly with backoff, until context expires or an error occurs.
